reviews.text: Been going here for over 10 yrs and feel like they treat you like family. In all my years using a groomer (over 30 yrs / 3 diff dogs), Joseph is my favorite groomer & I think produces dog show quality results. See photos :)

I just  went to this business  because  the other  y used to go the whole  schedule for the week was full, then they try to sell me the shots all for my dog, the lady on counter  not even asked me  If my dog has all shots, very bad service for that lady.
They did a great job on my Maxie. Exactly what I asked for, fast, and very pleasant

I don’t like to give negative reviews on small businesses, but in this circumstance it’s important to share…

They estimated it would take 2-4 hours for a full groom, and I ended up picking her up at the 6 hour mark. They didn’t start working on her until 4.5 hours in and I only know this because I had to reach out for status updates multiple times.

I asked for them to tighten up her long coat a little bit and they completely shaved her. They also knicked her nose and made her bleed, but never mentioned that.

When I asked for some sort of discount the most they would offer was 10%.

I understand that there are certain constraints they’re working under, but the lack of communication and poor service is disappointing. This was only my dog’s second groom, our first there, and needless to say she was exhausted by the time we got home and just wanted to be left alone which was very out of character.

This place is awesome! I needed a last-minute appointment for my three cats and they were able to take us in. I appreciated how quiet the space was when I came inside as my cats were able to adjust to the new environment pretty quickly. You can tell that the owners are definitely animal lovers cause when I got my cats back, they were calm and they looked great. I had to bring them in because one of them had caught fleas and given it to the rest of them so they were miserable. When I received them, they did not have a single flea on them, and therefore looked and smelled great. They even went as far as trimming their nails beautifully and making making sure they had a cute bandanna to be sent off with! They even went as far as to helping us apply the medication that our vet prescribed for the flea treatment. I definitely will be returning in the future and wanted to leave a review to encourage others who are looking for a new place to take their fur babies!

Love this place! I have two dogs, one of which is very fearful but they have been very accommodating and made the experience as easy as possible for all of us. I’ve been taking my own dogs and my mom’s to get groomed here for a few years now and will continue to do so.
They did a great job with my cat's first grooming.
Great grooming service.i have a cat and know how difficulty it is to groom a cat..results are amazing...definitely will come back

I cannot comment on the quality of care, but this is a deeply unserious business. They make you fill out an application as a new customer. They state they will get back to you within 24 hours. I got a reply in Closer to 2 weeks, at which point they made it embarrassingly clear that they didn't bother to read the application they forced me to complete before "accepting" me as a customer.

Received my dog with a cut ear and they must have glued the ear. This last visit they did not disclose any information about my dog being hurt while in their care. When speaking to the owner the owner blamed my dog for their lack of safety. Will not be returning to this establishment. The safety of pets should be their top priority and it clearly isn't.
They always take very good care of my boy and he always looks and smells great when coming home. He's a large husky with a thick coat and these guys do a fantastic job. Thank you.
